description: This file defines the OrderFacadeServlet class, a servlet handling order processing in an online grocery ordering system. It manages cart items, retrieves user payment and address data from HTTP requests, creates payment and sale records via utility classes, associates products with the sale, clears the cart, and redirects to a success or error page.

classes.name: OrderFacadeServlet
classes.description: Servlet handling order submission, payment processing, sale creation, and order finalization in the online grocery system.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the current shopping cart, create payment and sale records, associate products with the sale, and redirect users based on success or failure.
